patterns.usage_note: The te-form joint between clauses: で on voiced verb stems (呼んで, 泳いで), て elsewhere, くて on i-adjectives. It leaves the relation to context, so it reads as sequence, simultaneous description, or loose cause (重くて持てない). The other で entries are the particle on a noun — place (カフェで勉強する), means or cause (筆で書く, 風邪で休む), price or standard (半額で), group as doer (会社で) — and the copula's linking form (休みで).

examples.ruby: 友達[ともだち]を呼[よ]んで一緒[いっしょ]に晩[ばん]ご飯[はん]を作[つく]った。
examples.english: I invited a friend over and we made dinner together.

examples.ruby: セミが鳴[な]きやんで、庭[にわ]が急[きゅう]に静[しず]かになった。
examples.english: The cicadas stopped their racket and the garden went suddenly quiet.

examples.ruby: 荷物[にもつ]が重[おも]くて一人[ひとり]では持[も]てなかった。
examples.english: The luggage was so heavy I couldn't carry it alone.
